justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/Indent.java`, `Doc.java`, `DocBuilder.java`, `OpenOp.java`, `OpsBuilder.java`, and `java/JavaInputAstVisitor.java`. `Indent` is a small 2-nested-class value type (`Const`, `If`) whose only direct external dependencies are `MoreObjects` and `Output.BreakTag` (`Indent.java:17-18,25-83`).
